Shattered stone, scattered armor, and thin ember-lit fissures break the dark ground; distant fires glow through the haze. The woman keeps her body low and balanced, one hand braced against the dragon’s spiked crest, her shaved sides and small top knot catching the dull red light. The dragon’s near-black scales carry a blue-grey sheen, and its pale backswept horns and long spiked tail cut through the drifting smoke. Embers lift around them; the pair advances from the smoky distance toward the foreground, the battleground opening ahead.
